direction: Unified simplified gouache brushwork with distinct composition, viewpoint, cast, environment and accent palette per event.

images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one square 1:1 event vignette for a medieval fantasy game. Image 1 (fantasy-battle.png) is a BRUSHWORK reference ONLY: its simplified matte gouache painting, broad confident color masses, selective sharp detail and mature storybook drawing. The NEW scene must have its own distinct setting, palette and composition. Do NOT reuse the reference's cast, red-caped blonde knight, outdoor valley, mountains, blue sky or monster. This is a diverse event series, NOT a sequence of identical portraits in the same landscape.
Clear visual hierarchy: ONE focal object/action, about 75% quiet supporting color masses. Two or three values per material, broad organic brush edges and softened peripheral shapes. No dense texture, tiny repeated decorative marks, chipped stone noise, grass blades, leaf-by-leaf foliage, woodgrain, engraving, ornate filigree, piles of props, hard black outlines, photorealism, glossy anime, 3D or flat vector art. Keep the focal object and important hands within central 70%. Bright or softly luminous daylight, NO dark scene or black vignette. The periphery should be light and subdued. No text, writing, runes shaped like letters, UI, captions, border, signature, logo or watermark.
EVENT: 遗忘的圣匣 / Forgotten Reliquary. DISTINCT SHOT: a steep THREE-QUARTER OVERHEAD CLOSE-UP looking down at a SMALL HEXAGONAL IVORY-AND-SILVER RELIQUARY on a circular pale jade stone altar, INSIDE a roofless ancient shrine. The lid is slightly open, with one small luminous VIOLET CRYSTAL relic in the gap. Just ONE brown-gloved adventurer's hand enters from the lower right and gently wipes a broad dusty mark away from the lid. NO face, NO full person, NO conventional wooden treasure chest. The altar's circular silhouette and hexagonal reliquary create a distinctive geometric composition. Two soft column shadows cross large blank ivory floor slabs. A little broad sage moss at one edge only. PALETTE: luminous ivory, pale jade, muted cool silver, a concentrated lavender-violet glow. Sunlight falls in one broad diagonal shaft. No landscape, no sky, no blue mountains. Focus on the casket, the small violet relic and touching hand; everything else is simple low-contrast temple floor. Restrained magic, no particles or elaborate decorations.

EVENT: 旅人的药剂 / Traveler's Potion. DISTINCT SHOT: an intimate EYE-LEVEL CLOSE-UP of a traveling ALCHEMIST'S OPEN MEDICINE SATCHEL and a gift passed across its top, under a forest awning. At center a friendly elderly alchemist's plain linen-sleeved hand offers ONE rounded glass bottle of ROSE-MAGENTA potion; a receiving leather-gloved hand reaches in from the lower left. A small part of the alchemist's warm smiling gray-bearded face is cropped in the upper right, NOT two full standing people. The open amber-brown wooden medicine box fills the lower third with only THREE broad plain bottle silhouettes and one folded sage cloth. A soft canopy of warm leaves and cream canvas fills the quiet background, NO sky or mountain panorama. PALETTE: honey amber, warm terracotta skin, muted mint and olive, a vivid rose-pink focal potion. Differentiate this from a jade relic scene. Keep surfaces largely plain and simplify the satchel, hands and few bottles. The offered potion and nearby fingers are the ONE sharp point of focus; the partial face and background are loose supporting shapes.

EVENT: 岔路的援军 / Crossroads Reinforcements. DISTINCT SHOT: a slightly LOW eye-level view from inside a broad OCHRE RECRUITING TENT looking toward its bright cream opening. A tall dark-skinned new spearman in simple SLATE-BLUE mail and an ochre shoulder mantle stands at the center, presenting ONE broad rolled TACTICAL PARCHMENT over a plain waist-high map table. To one side a short sturdy dwarf recruit with a simple round helmet waits; on the other side only a leather-gloved receiving arm enters the composition, no blonde commander portrait. TWO recruits only. A single large muted crimson pennant and the tent's triangular opening frame them as big graphic shapes. The scroll and presenting recruit's expression are the focal point; the dwarf is smaller, softer and lower contrast. No handshake pose, no sunny mountain landscape, no grass field and no expansive blue sky. PALETTE: slate blue, ochre canvas, warm copper skin and a restrained crimson accent, with bright soft daylight spilling into the tent. Broad plain armor, no chainmail microtexture or little equipment. The parchment has no text or fine map marks. Show recruitment and acquiring tactics clearly.

EVENT: 篝火 / Campfire. DISTINCT SHOT: a HIGH OVERHEAD VIEW straight down at a cozy campfire, a circular composition. A small grouped ORANGE FLAME and three broad dark logs occupy the center. Around it, just parts of resting travelers are visible: a pair of plain boots at the upper edge, a gloved hand warming itself near the lower right, one simple clay cup at the left, and a folded muted plum bedroll along one corner. NO faces, NO full seated figures, NO tents or banners, NO sky or landscape panorama. The fire is the ONE focal point and circle center. A soft afternoon light makes the entire event vignette bright, not nocturnal. PALETTE: warm peach, amber orange fire, muted plum and soft lavender gray, small ochre cloth accent. Quiet surroundings and simple travel objects communicate rest, recovery and preparing to march again. No dense sparks, no many cups or equipment, no woodgrain, no grass texture. Clear negative space between the few shapes.

EVENT: 遗弃兵营 / Abandoned Barracks. DISTINCT SHOT: a quiet WIDE oblique view of an EMPTY derelict camp, NO people at all. One collapsed, SUN-BLEACHED ROSE-BEIGE canvas tent stretches across the upper part as a large soft muted triangular shape. A broken pole leans toward the empty pale tent doorway. At lower center a small OPEN ROUGH SUPPLY CRATE contains ONE plain cloth pouch with THREE large gold coins lying beside it, which is the small crisp focal point. This is mundane scavenged supplies, NOT a luxurious treasure chest: no brass bands or gem lock. A broad long soft tent shadow crosses simple pale sandy earth diagonally. A short faded rust-red torn pennant hangs limp from the broken pole. PALETTE: dusty rose, faded linen cream, warm sand, muted clay red and desaturated olive-gray shadow; very little blue. Absolutely no mountains, no pretty grass meadow, no castle, no trees, no corpses and no battlefield debris. Make emptiness and abandonment the distinctive mood, but in bright warm daylight. Most of the composition is quiet pale ground and soft tent fabric; no tiny fraying, chips or scattered junk.

EVENT: 遗物宝箱 / Relic Treasure Chest, CLOSED STATE. DISTINCT SHOT: a large OBJECT CLOSE-UP of one LOW RECTANGULAR DARK WALNUT TREASURE CHEST with a FLAT CLOSED LID, shown from a slightly low three-quarter view. TWO broad plain weathered IRON-GRAY bands and a single simple BRASS RING LATCH, with a small flat RED WAX SEAL, make its silhouette easily distinguishable from the ivory hexagonal temple reliquary. The chest occupies about 65% of the frame width near the center-lower and stands on one broad cream limestone slab. NO person or hands. Two very simple large muted fern silhouettes enter only from the lower corners; surrounding background is a softly painted PALE SAGE AND CREAM clearing, without sky, mountains, path or detailed landscape. PALETTE: rich walnut brown, cool charcoal iron, warm brass, creamy stone and restrained pale fern green, with a tiny vermilion seal accent. Bright diffuse daylight, no black background. The chest should be the one readable dark-on-light focal object against large very quiet pale areas. Keep the lid completely CLOSED and contents invisible. No gems on the lock, no inscriptions, engraving or many rivets, no woodgrain microtexture, no coins, no elaborate props. This exact image needs a matching open state later: stable camera, simple uncluttered surroundings.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the game's new CLOSED treasure chest illustration. Produce its precisely matching OPEN STATE. Keep the same square canvas, original mature simplified gouache brushwork, diffuse bright daylight, camera, large low rectangular walnut chest base and its two broad iron-gray bands, limestone slab, pale sage clearing, soft distant ruins and large quiet fern silhouettes. Change only the FLAT LID so it is hinged upward OPEN toward the back; keep the chest base at exactly the same size, position and perspective. Break the little red wax seal cleanly at the latch. Inside show ONE modest ancient brass AMULET on plain soft cream cloth, glowing with a restrained warm golden light. The amulet is a simple broad sun-disc shape with no lettering or tiny engraving, no turquoise gemstone. It represents a random relic reward. No coins, no extra loot, no particles or explosion of light, no people or hands, no new props. The chest and single relic remain the clear focal subject, and all peripheral areas stay light, quiet and lower contrast. No change to surroundings or framing, no dark or black vignette, no text, UI, watermark or logo. This will toggle directly with the supplied closed-state painting.
